note: The arsenal's names inside the world (design doc section 5, stage 1): every weapon, attachment, camo, perk, deathstreak, killstreak and piece of equipment, keyed by MW2's own internal names (weapons by weapon name, attachments by id, camos by model suffix, perks by specialty, killstreaks by MW2's streak name). The client reads this file; the server's table (server/src/fusion/src/ArsenalTable.cpp) is generated from it by server/contrib/fusion/make_arsenal_names.py and a fusion test holds the two together. Swap names here, then run the script.

famas_mp.name: Gnomish Burst Repeater
famas_mp.origin: Gnomeregan's clockwork bullpup spits three rounds before the trigger is fully back. Tinkers still stamp the old FA-MAS pattern number on the stock.

m4_mp.name: Stormwind Guard Carbine
m4_mp.origin: Issued to the Stormwind City Guard since the Second War: light, reliable and easy to mend. Every one leaves the Cathedral Square armoury as a Mark IV-A1.

scar_mp.name: Theramore Marine Rifle
scar_mp.origin: Jaina's harbour forges fit a heavy round into a light frame for Theramore's marines. The quartermasters call it the Special Combat H.

tavor_mp.name: Darkspear Bullpup
tavor_mp.origin: Darkspear smiths copied a dwarven bullpup and filed it short for jungle fighting. Under the voodoo charms it is stamped T-21.

fal_mp.name: Undercity Reclaimer
fal_mp.origin: Forsaken salvagers rebuild old Lordaeron line rifles from ruined armouries. The FL pattern still kills the living as well as it did.

m16_mp.name: Kul Tiran Burst Rifle
m16_mp.origin: Kul Tiras arms its marines with this three-round burst rifle, oiled against salt air. Admiralty ledgers list it as the sixteen-pattern, fourth mark.

masada_mp.name: Ironforge Battle Rifle
masada_mp.origin: Forged in the Great Forge for the Ironforge Mountaineers, as steady as the dwarf behind it. Bronzebeard Arms model ACR-6.

fn2000_mp.name: Quel'dorei Sunrifle
fn2000_mp.origin: High elf rangers carry this sleek bullpup, its frame grown from runewood around a sunstone ejector. Silvermoon's artificers mark it F-2000.

ak47_mp.name: Orgrimmar War Rifle
ak47_mp.origin: Hammered out by the thousand in the Cleft of Shadow: crude, loud and nearly impossible to break. Grunts call it the Kalashnak, after its first smith.

ump45_mp.name: Gnomeregan Pulse Carbine
ump45_mp.origin: Rebuilt around a pulse-fed bolt after the fall of Gnomeregan; slow, heavy rounds that land hard. Tinker's mark U-45.

mp5k_mp.name: Kirin Tor Manacell SMG
mp5k_mp.origin: A compact repeater driven by Kirin Tor mana cells that someone stole from Dalaran. The Violet Citadel denies ever making the MP-5 Kurz.

kriss_mp.name: Venture Co. Ripsaw
kriss_mp.origin: Venture Co. engineers fold the recoil down into a steam piston so it fires faster than its wearer can pay for rounds. Catalogue number V-ector 45.

p90_mp.name: Tinkertown Peppergun
p90_mp.origin: Fifty rounds in a clear gnomish drum laid across the top: mostly magazine, and the gnomes like it that way. Model P-90.

uzi_mp.name: Blackwater Bilge Sprayer
uzi_mp.origin: The Blackwater Raiders swear by this cheap little sprayer for clearing a crowded deck. Pressed in a Booty Bay shop that stamps it U-Z mini.

sa80_mp.name: Stromgarde Support Rifle
sa80_mp.origin: The last free soldiers of Stromgarde fit a long barrel and a bipod to hold the Arathi walls. Armoury list L-86.

rpd_mp.name: Frostwolf Drum Gun
rpd_mp.origin: Fed from a battered hundred-round drum, it came over the Alterac passes from the dwarves and never went back. Frostwolf smiths keep the R-PD pattern.

mg4_mp.name: Wildhammer Thunder Gun
mg4_mp.origin: Aerie Peak's gryphon riders strip it from their saddle mounts to fight on foot. Its Wildhammer gunsmith marks it MG-4.

aug_mp.name: Uldaman Heavy Barrel
aug_mp.origin: A titan-forged heavy barrel the Explorers' League dug out of Uldaman, set in a dwarven stock. Nobody knows who made the A-UG original.

m240_mp.name: Dark Iron Magmacore Gun
m240_mp.origin: A belt gun fed by a molten core in its receiver; it runs hot enough to glow. Shadowforge City makes it to the 240th Thaurissan pattern.

cheytac_mp.name: Mountaineer's Longshot
cheytac_mp.origin: Ironforge's Mountaineers hunt across Dun Morogh's peaks with this bolt rifle and its Ironforge-ground glass. Rifle-guild number CT-408.

barrett_mp.name: Thorium Siege Rifle
barrett_mp.origin: The Thorium Brotherhood's anti-golem rifle: a fifty-calibre thorium round in a self-loading frame. Stamped B-82 at Thorium Point.

wa2000_mp.name: Sentinel Moonglass Rifle
wa2000_mp.origin: Darnassian Sentinels set night elf moonglass optics on a bullpup frame; it sees best by moonlight. The Temple of the Moon logs it as W-2000.

m21_mp.name: Argent Marksman Rifle
m21_mp.origin: The Argent Dawn's marksmen watch the Plaguelands with this blessed battle rifle. Light's Hope armoury pattern M-21.

spas12_mp.name: Bilgewater Scattercannon
spas12_mp.origin: The Bilgewater Cartel's pump-action pressure-blaster, sold with the price tag still on. Cartel model SP-12.

aa12_mp.name: Gadgetzan Auto-Scattergun
aa12_mp.origin: Gadgetzan's arena bookies keep one under the counter: drum-fed, steam-cooled, fully automatic, rarely legal. Steamwheedle code AA-12.

striker_mp.name: Zandalari Drum Shotgun
striker_mp.origin: A twelve-shell revolving drum carved with Zandalari runes. The pattern reached the islands on a wrecked goblin freighter named the Striker.

ranger_mp.name: Westfall Coach Gun
ranger_mp.origin: Westfall farmers keep this double-barrelled gun by the door for Defias raiders, sawn short. The Saldean family sells it as the Ranger.

m1014_mp.name: Menethil Breaching Gun
m1014_mp.origin: Menethil Harbor's guards clear smugglers' holds with this self-loading breacher. Shipped in crates marked M-1014.

model1887_mp.name: Thunder Bluff Lever-Gun
model1887_mp.origin: Tauren braves work the lever of this heavy scattergun one-handed; Thunder Bluff's kodo hunters made it famous. Totem-carved 1887.

usp_mp.name: Apothecary's Plague Pistol
usp_mp.origin: The Royal Apothecary Society's sidearm, chambered for its plague-tipped rounds and issued to every Deathguard. Society pattern U-SP 45.

coltanaconda_mp.name: Crossroads Hand Cannon
coltanaconda_mp.origin: A heavy six-chamber revolver the Crossroads caravan guards trade for. Its frame came off a goblin barge called the Anaconda.

beretta_mp.name: Lion's Pride Sidearm
beretta_mp.origin: Every Alliance officer carries one: Stormwind steel, fifteen rounds and a lion's head on the grip. Officer's pattern M-9.

deserteagle_mp.name: Tanaris Sandhawk
deserteagle_mp.origin: A goblin hand cannon built for the dunes, firing a round big enough to stop a basilisk. Steamwheedle sells it as the Desert-E.

pp2000_mp.name: Gnomish Pocket Repeater
pp2000_mp.origin: A folding machine pistol small enough for a gnome's pocket and loud enough for a dwarf's. Tinker's mark P-2000.

glock_mp.name: Defias Gutter Pistol
glock_mp.origin: The Defias Brotherhood file their sidearms to fire fully automatic; Westfall hears them at night. The file marks read G-18.

beretta393_mp.name: Syndicate Burst Pistol
beretta393_mp.origin: Alterac's Syndicate prefer this three-round burst pistol: quiet hands, quick work. Ravenholdt fences call it the M-93.

tmp_mp.name: Ravenholdt Machine Pistol
tmp_mp.origin: The assassins of Ravenholdt Manor carry this compact machine pistol under a cloak. The manor's armourer lists it as the T-MP.

at4_mp.name: Ironforge Tunnel Breaker
at4_mp.origin: A single-shot tube Ironforge's sappers carry into the deep tunnels and throw away once fired. Sapper issue AT-4.

m79_mp.name: Tinkertown Thumper
m79_mp.origin: A break-action gun that lobs a fist-sized charge in a lazy arc. Tinkertown sells it as the M-79, everyone calls it the Thumper.

stinger_mp.name: Wildhammer Skyhunter
stinger_mp.origin: Built by the Wildhammer to bring down Dark Iron flying machines; it locks onto their heat. Aerie Peak calls the pattern the Stinger.

javelin_mp.name: Titan-Forged Starlance
javelin_mp.origin: A guided lance restored from Uldaman's vaults: it climbs high, then falls on its mark. The Explorers' League catalogues it as the Javelin.

rpg_mp.name: Steamwheedle Rocket Tube
rpg_mp.origin: The Steamwheedle Cartel's unguided rocket tube, sold to anyone with gold and gloriously unreliable. Cartel model R-PG 7.

riotshield_mp.name: Argent Bulwark
riotshield_mp.origin: A thorium-plated shield with a viewing slit, carried by the Argent Dawn's front rank against the Scourge.

frag_grenade_mp.name: Thorium Grenade
frag_grenade_mp.origin: A thorium-cased fragmentation grenade from the Thorium Brotherhood's forges. Brotherhood pattern M-67.

semtex_mp.name: Goblin Sticky Bomb
semtex_mp.origin: A Bilgewater sapper charge in a resin that clings to whatever it hits. The goblins swear the filler is Semtex-grade.

throwingknife_mp.name: Ravenholdt Throwing Knife
throwingknife_mp.origin: Balanced steel from Ravenholdt's armoury; a good throw ends a fight, a bad one arms the enemy.

claymore_mp.name: Gnomish Tripwire Mine
claymore_mp.origin: A directional mine with a wire sensor, 'Front toward enemy' printed in Gnomish. Gnomeregan's mine works call it the Claymore.

c4_mp.name: Seaforium Charge
c4_mp.origin: Goblin seaforium packed in a clay brick with a remote trigger. Engineers label the bricks C-4.

flash_grenade_mp.name: Arcane Flash Bomb
flash_grenade_mp.origin: A canister of raw arcane light that blinds and deafens; a Dalaran apprentice's mistake, now issued. Casing stamped M-84.

concussion_grenade_mp.name: Dwarven Thunder Charge
concussion_grenade_mp.origin: A dwarven charge that hits like a warrior's Thunderclap and leaves its victims stumbling.

smoke_grenade_mp.name: Gnomish Smoke Canister
smoke_grenade_mp.origin: Gnomish fog in a can: thick, grey and faintly smelling of oil. Canister type M-18.

uav_mp.name: Gnomish Spy Gyro
uav_mp.origin: A gnomish spy gyro circles overhead and marks every enemy below on your map.

remotemissile_projectile_mp.name: Goblin Rocket
remotemissile_projectile_mp.origin: A goblin rocket car with its wheels taken off and far too much powder in it, steered down from the sky by you.

sentry_gun_mp.name: Dwarven Sentry Turret
sentry_gun_mp.origin: A dwarven field cannon on a swivel, set down for a run of kills; it turns on anything hostile in front of it.

harrier_ffar_mp.name: Gnomish Sky Hornets
harrier_ffar_mp.origin: A gnomish flying machine drops three bombs on your mark, then hovers to hunt what is left with rockets.

cobra_20mm_mp.name: Gyrocopter Gunship
cobra_20mm_mp.origin: A gnomish gyrocopter with an explosive cannon, circling your position.

cobra_player_minigun_mp.name: Sky Rider Gunship
cobra_player_minigun_mp.origin: A gryphon rider or wind rider with a repeating gun, circling your position.

stealth_bomb_mp.name: Siege Bomber
stealth_bomb_mp.origin: A dwarven bomber or a Kor'kron wind rider lays a line of goblin bombs across your mark.

nuke_mp.name: Gnomeregan Radiation Bomb
nuke_mp.origin: What drove the gnomes out of Gnomeregan, packed into a bomb. Everyone loses.

reflex.name: Gnomish Red Dot
reflex.origin: Gnomish lens glass with a glowing red dot etched inside. A reflex sight.

silencer.name: Shadowmuffle Suppressor
silencer.origin: A baffled can lined with shadowcloth; Ravenholdt swears by it. Shorter reach, no tracer on the map.

acog.name: Moonglass Scope
acog.origin: Night elf moonglass in a dwarven mount: a four-power sight for the middle distance. ACOG pattern.

gl.name: Underslung Bombard
gl.origin: A goblin forty-millimetre bombard bolted under the barrel.

fmj.name: Thorium-Jacketed Rounds
fmj.origin: Rounds sheathed in thorium that punch through walls and armour. Full metal jacket.

shotgun.name: Underslung Scattergun
shotgun.origin: A short four-shell scattergun mounted under the barrel for close work.

grip.name: Dwarven Foregrip
grip.origin: A carved ironwood grip that keeps the muzzle down.

rof.name: Gnomish Overclock
rof.origin: A gnomish spring that makes the action cycle faster, and kick harder. Rapid fire.

akimbo.name: Twin-Fisted
akimbo.origin: One in each hand, orc style. Akimbo.

tactical.name: Rogue's Tactical Knife
tactical.origin: A knife held under the pistol for a faster stab.

eotech.name: Arcane Holo-Sight
eotech.origin: A mage-etched reticle hanging in clear air. A holographic sight.

thermal.name: Dwarven Heatglass Scope
thermal.origin: Glass ground from Searing Gorge obsidian that shows bodies by their heat. A thermal sight.

heartbeat.name: Druidic Lifebeat Sensor
heartbeat.origin: A Cenarion charm that hears hearts beat nearby, through walls. A heartbeat sensor.

xmags.name: Goblin Extended Drums
xmags.origin: Bigger goblin magazines: more rounds before the reload.

_woodland.name: Ashenvale Woodland
_woodland.origin: The greens and browns of Ashenvale's canopy. Woodland camo.

_desert.name: Tanaris Dunes
_desert.origin: Sand and sun-bleached stone from the Tanaris desert. Desert camo.

_arctic.name: Winterspring Frost
_arctic.origin: Snow and ice-blue shadow from Winterspring. Arctic camo.

_digital.name: Gnomish Circuitry
_digital.origin: A gnomish grid pattern printed by a machine that never sleeps. Digital camo.

_red_urban.name: Stormwind Cobble
_red_urban.origin: Greys and brick reds from Stormwind's streets. Urban camo.

_red_tiger.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
_red_tiger.origin: The stripes of a Stranglethorn tiger, red as a troll's warpaint. Red tiger camo.

_blue_tiger.name: Feralas Bluestripe
_blue_tiger.origin: Blue stripes after the frostsabers of the Feralas highlands. Blue tiger camo.

_orange_fall.name: Duskwood Autumn
_orange_fall.origin: The orange of Duskwood's dying leaves. Fall camo.

specialty_marathon.name: Windrunner's Stride
specialty_marathon.origin: The Farstriders teach their rangers to run without end. Unlimited sprint (Marathon).

specialty_fastreload.name: Goblin Quick-Loader
specialty_fastreload.origin: A spring-fed loader of goblin make. Faster reloads (Sleight of Hand).

specialty_scavenger.name: Gravedigger's Bandolier
specialty_scavenger.origin: Forsaken habit: take every round from the fallen (Scavenger).

specialty_bling.name: Tinker's Rails
specialty_bling.origin: Gnomish mounting rails take a second attachment (Bling).

specialty_onemanarmy.name: Field Quartermaster
specialty_onemanarmy.origin: Carry the whole armoury on your back and change kit anywhere (One Man Army).

specialty_bulletdamage.name: Thorium-Core Loads
specialty_bulletdamage.origin: Rounds packed around a thorium core hit harder (Stopping Power).

specialty_lightweight.name: Runeweave Kit
specialty_lightweight.origin: Night elf runeweave makes gear weigh nothing. Faster movement (Lightweight).

specialty_hardline.name: Mercenary Contract
specialty_hardline.origin: Goblin contractors deliver a kill sooner. Killstreaks need one kill fewer (Hardline).

specialty_coldblooded.name: Shadowcloak Weave
specialty_coldblooded.origin: A cloak no spy gyro or heatglass can see (Cold-Blooded).

specialty_dangerclose.name: Sapper's Training
specialty_dangerclose.origin: Ironforge's sappers pack their charges tighter. Stronger explosives (Danger Close).

specialty_commando.name: Warrior's Charge
specialty_commando.origin: A warrior's leap into the fight. Longer knife lunge (Commando).

specialty_steadyaim.name: Hunter's Steady Hand
specialty_steadyaim.origin: A hunter's calm. Tighter hip fire (Steady Aim).

specialty_localjammer.name: Arcane Disruptor
specialty_localjammer.origin: A charm that fills enemy maps with arcane noise (Scrambler).

specialty_quieter.name: Rogue's Soft Step
specialty_quieter.origin: Silent feet that no lifebeat sensor hears (Ninja).

specialty_bombsquad.name: Sapper's Eye
specialty_bombsquad.origin: See the enemy's mines and charges through walls (SitRep).

specialty_pistoldeath.name: Last Rites
specialty_pistoldeath.origin: Downed, draw the sidearm and fight on (Last Stand).

specialty_copycat.name: Faceless Mimicry
specialty_copycat.origin: Take your killer's kit as your own, as the Faceless do (Copycat).

specialty_painkiller.name: Berserker's Draught
specialty_painkiller.origin: A troll draught that numbs pain for a few seconds after you return (Painkiller).

specialty_grenadepulldeath.name: Dead Man's Switch
specialty_grenadepulldeath.origin: A goblin habit: drop a live grenade as you fall (Martyrdom).

specialty_finalstand.name: Stand of the Fallen
specialty_finalstand.origin: Downed, fight back and rise again (Final Stand).

uav.name: Gnomish Spy Gyro
uav.origin: A gnomish spy gyro circles overhead and marks every enemy below on your map. UAV.

airdrop.name: Goblin Cargo Drop
airdrop.origin: A goblin zeppelin drops a crate with a random killstreak inside. Care package.

counter_uav.name: Arcane Static Gyro
counter_uav.origin: A gyro that fills the sky with arcane static and blinds enemy maps. Counter-UAV.

sentry.name: Dwarven Sentry Turret
sentry.origin: A dwarven field cannon on a swivel: set it down within six yards and it fires on the hostiles in front of it for a minute and a half, until the enemy shoots it apart. Sentry gun.

predator_missile.name: Goblin Rocket
predator_missile.origin: A goblin rocket you steer from the sky: the mouse aims, a click lights the second stage. Predator missile.

precision_airstrike.name: Gryphon Bombing Run
precision_airstrike.origin: Wildhammer gryphon riders drop their bombs along your mark. Precision airstrike.

harrier_airstrike.name: Gnomish Sky Hornets
harrier_airstrike.origin: A gnomish flying machine bombs your mark, then hovers over it firing rockets. Harrier strike.

helicopter.name: Sky Rider Gunship
helicopter.origin: A Wildhammer gryphon rider (Alliance) or a Kor'kron wind rider (Horde) circles you for a minute and shoots the enemies in the open, whoever is on you first. Attack helicopter.

airdrop_mega.name: Goblin Freight Barrage
airdrop_mega.origin: Four goblin crates from a zeppelin at once. Emergency airdrop.

helicopter_flares.name: Thandol Heavy Gyrocopter
helicopter_flares.origin: An armoured dwarven gyrocopter with flares and two gunners. Pave Low.

stealth_airstrike.name: Siege Bomber
stealth_airstrike.origin: A dwarven bomber (Alliance) or a Kor'kron wind rider bomber (Horde) flies over your mark along your facing and lays nine goblin bombs. Stealth bomber.

helicopter_minigun.name: Gyrocopter Gunship
helicopter_minigun.origin: A gnomish gyrocopter circles you for a minute, shelling your enemies with an explosive cannon. Chopper gunner.

ac130.name: Zeppelin Gunship
ac130.origin: A goblin war zeppelin circling with cannons, and you aboard. AC-130.

emp.name: Arcane Pulse
emp.origin: A Kirin Tor overload that kills every gnomish gadget and enemy map in the area. EMP.

nuke.name: Gnomeregan Radiation Bomb
nuke.origin: What drove the gnomes out of Gnomeregan, packed into a bomb. Tactical nuke.
